text:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR #17292 is failing CI on shard-9 with a flaky kv-cache integration test. Can someone on-call kick off a targeted rerun or advise?

ci-bot: Build 17292 (commit abc123) failed on shard-9. Failing test: kv_cache_integration::test_prefix_eviction
Logs: ```
E   AssertionError: expected 3 items, got 4
    at tests/kv_cache/test_integration.rs:234
    Caused by: race in eviction scheduling (timing dependent)
```

maya: I ran that test locally once and saw it too — looks timing-y. Increasing the eviction window or adding a small sleep fixed it for me. Not great but helpful for a quick green.

jordan: Do we need a snapshot update here or is it a pure flake? The failure looks like a count mismatch not a snapshot diff.

alex: Not a snapshot update — it's an assertion, probably non-deterministic ordering. If we can do a targeted rerun and it passes, we can merge. If it repros consistently we should add an issue and a short-term skip with a TODO.

samir: @oncall I can run the rerun now. Command I used before: `buildkite-agent artifact download "build-17292-log" . && buildkite-agent annotate --style success "Targeted rerun started"` — or just trigger the specific job: `bk retry --build 17292 --job "shard-9-integration"`

maya: If rerun passes, please add a note in the PR about the flake and link the issue for follow-up. We should avoid snapshot churn for flakes like this.

triage-bot: Label added: flaky/test-kv-cache. Linked issue template: https://go/infra/flaky-tests.

ci-bot: Targeted rerun started for job shard-9-integration (attempt 2). Watch: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/17292/jobs/shard-9-integration

alex: Thanks @samir and @ci-bot — I'll wait for the rerun. If it passes I'll request final approval and merge during the next merge window. If it fails again, I'll open a proper flaky-test ticket and push a small timeout increase + note for the test owner. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks — also pinging @jordan for a quick review if the rerun is green and you can approve.

jordan: Will do, will check the rerun results in ~10m.

ci-bot: Rerun succeeded (attempt 2). All checks green for shard-9-integration.

alex: Great — requesting approval now. tagging @jordan @maya for final sign-off.

jordan: Approved. Merge when ready.

alex: Merged. I'll open a follow-up ticket to add a targeted fix or more robust timing in test. Thanks all. :rocket:
